snapshotDescription: Before the first part of the model-cards admission (2026-11-03): the 20 compared cards as documents, their sources, publication by the developer and citations of framework editions already in the dataset, on existing predicates. No schema change.
scope: The first part of the model-cards admission (2026-11-03) adds, from a machine-prepared, machine-audited and cross-family-checked candidate pack and under the maintainer's decisions of 2026-11-03, twenty system cards, model cards and safety reports of Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI and xAI (2023–2026) as documents with the expression read, their publication by the developer, each dated as the card prints it, and the card's citation of a framework edition already in the dataset where the card identifies one. A card that prints no date of its own has an unknown date; repository commit dates are not card dates. Publication and citation are not evidence that the evaluations a card describes were carried out as described. All records are seeds.
